Jonas —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. A couple of follow-ups from our compliance team as we close out the SLA order form:

- We need a confirmed timeline for irreversible purges of EU customer data when it is flagged for deletion (we currently require maximum 21 days from request). Can you confirm Redwood can support a 14-day hard-delete window for EU-resident data?

We’d like a short note in the order form referencing the exportable audit artifacts and the cadence.

Laura —

Really useful list, thanks. Quick answers below and attaching a draft of the order form clause (redwood-proposed-sla-geo-wipe-v2.pdf).

- 14-day hard-delete window: Yes, we can support a 14-day irreversible purge for EU-resident data when the customer opts into the bespoke window on the order form. The default is 30 days; bespoke windows are applied per-customer and are enforced by our residency controller.
- Reversibility and legal holds: While in the pre-purge (quarantine) period the deletion is reversible via a signed support request; the legal-hold state can be extended up to 180 days if you provide documented legal justification. After the irreversible purge event the data is unrecoverable.
- Certificate & audit artifact: We can emit a signed PDF certificate of destruction and an immutable audit record that contains the purge job id, timestamp, operator-id, and a SHA256 hash of the job output. We'll surface the record via the customer console and deliver a PDF on request.

Monica (ops) and Neha (security) are looped for any technical caveats.

Next steps I propose: 1) you mark the bespoke 14-day window on the order form, 2) we add the certificate-of-destruction clause, 3) we ship an amended order form for electronic signature.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Hi team —

Answers inline to Procurement's asks: 

1) Change notice & cost: Changes to bespoke retention windows can be requested with 30 days' notice prior to the next billing cycle; we do not charge a reconfiguration fee for a single change. If requests are frequent (more than 3 changes in a rolling 12 months) we reserve the right to charge an operational adjustment fee — we'll note that in the order form language.

2) Certificate contents: Yes — we will include customer account id and order form reference on the certificate PDF. We'll also include the purge job id and an audit hash.

3) Delivery SLA: We commit to delivering the certificate within 3 business days of purge completion for EU-region hard-deletes. For expedited needs we can offer 24-hour delivery as a paid add-on.

Additional operational note: For legal holds, data will move to a labeled "legal_hold" bucket; deletion timers will pause until certified release from Sierra's legal team. We store legal-hold metadata for audit but do not keep payloads beyond the hold expiry unless re-authorized.

I've attached an annotated order-form (sierra-amended-orderform-annotations.docx) with the proposed clause text and redlines.

Monica Patel
Principal Customer Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference
